locator: I q.103 a.3 co.: government is nothing but the directing of the things governed to the end
interpretation: Part of the argument that the world is governed by one: 'government is nothing but the directing of the things governed to the end; which consists in some good'. Read in the direction the bridge needs: to direct a thing to an end is to govern it. Basis: the English Dominican translation (web snapshot); a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness of q.103 exists.
